::: {.tagline}
After 30 years, the MSMS water probe is still rolling!
:::

Thirty years ago, Michel Sanner introduced MSMS, a program for computing molecular surfaces.

Originally developed for molecular modeling and visualization, MSMS remains in use today,
including in modern geometric deep-learning research.


We are pleased to celebrate this milestone and grateful to the community that has continued to
use and build upon MSMS over the years.
